correctness.rationale: The source fixed-dimension equations are exactly equivalent to \(H_p(r)=M_1/M_2\) with \(p=n-2\) and \(H_p\) a ratio of positive radial-harmonic integrals. For fixed radius, \(\partial_p\log H_p\) is a strict positive difference of weighted \(\log s\) means on two separated intervals; for fixed \(p\), \(H_p\) is strictly increasing in radius. This proves strict dimension ordering. The exact rescaled equation bounds the high-dimensional offset, first proving \(p(r-R_1)\to0\) and then yielding the stated asymptotic by factors that each converge to one.
